Header (desktop and mobile) and footer page and service links derive their Swedish labels, hrefs and order from the typed route registry, so a route edit is one declaration in src/data/siteContent.ts instead of parallel markup edits.

An open mobile menu closes on Escape from a link or the focused toggle, restores focus to the toggle and can reopen; the toggle also closes it by click. Tab and Shift+Tab are not cancelled. Escape elsewhere in the header leaves the menu and focus unchanged.

test_references.supports: Raw-CSS check pins html scroll-behavior: smooth as the unconditional default rule before the reduced-motion block in styles.css. It inspects stylesheet text and does not exercise browser scrolling or the skip link itself.

test_references.name: sets html scroll-behavior to auto only inside the prefers-reduced-motion block
test_references.supports: Raw-CSS check pins the single prefers-reduced-motion override to html scroll-behavior: auto, so keyboard skip navigation stays unanimated for reduced-motion visitors. It inspects stylesheet text and does not exercise browser scrolling.

preconditions: React has mounted and the page shell is rendered.
flow: Reach Hoppa till innehåll before the repeated header navigation.
Activate the #content link to bypass the header.
Read the routed body or current availability message.
variants: The link is visually hidden until focused, when existing focus styles reveal it.
Ready home, subpage and in-app not-found views share a focusable #content wrapper with scroll margin.
The empty-services state retains one #content section but does not give that section tabindex=-1.
user_stories.expected_outcome: A stable page-body anchor is available before header navigation on all rendered states; ready content has a programmatically focusable destination.
user_stories.failure_behavior: A host error before React mounts cannot offer the link. The empty-services section has an anchor but no explicit focusability attribute; browser focus/scroll behavior is not established by DOM assertions.
user_stories.recovery: Use ordinary keyboard navigation if anchor behavior is unavailable; a missing static entry document requires host/artifact repair.

capability.current_limitations: A configured mail client is required. The site stores no inquiry, tracks no delivery and displays no confirmed-send state; the VAT basis of the offered rate relies on the visitor's description.
capability.failure_behavior: Custom Swedish validation blocks blank required fields, a malformed email and a missing, non-numeric or negative rate with per-field messages and an alert summary; a missing or incompatible mail client can prevent handoff without a site error receipt.
capability.recovery: Correct the named fields, or use the displayed address and the reopen-draft fallback link in a working mail client. Retype or copy details; the site offers no persistent draft recovery.
capability.customer_outcome: Companies can prepare a staffing inquiry addressed to the company with assignment, rate, duration and contact details.
outcome_signals: In an observed browser task, the nine inquiry controls can be located in mockup order with required and optional marks.
Submitting invalid input names each blocking field in Swedish and opens no draft.
A valid submit exposes the kontakt@svardentreprenad.se draft with its subject and labeled body, and the visitor is told they send the email themselves.

user_stories.title: Prepare a staffing inquiry with company and assignment details
user_stories.action: enter company details, needed help, offered hourly rate, duration and description
user_stories.benefit: give the company a useful basis to reply to the staffing request

test_references.name: collects the nine fields in mockup order with required and optional marks
test_references.supports: Checks field order, required/optional attributes, autocomplete hints, the rate minimum, the VAT note association, the guidance aside and the handoff note. Does not establish visual layout.

test_references.name: explains every missing required field in Swedish and focuses the first invalid field
test_references.supports: Checks the alert summary, the seven per-field Swedish messages, aria-invalid/aria-describedby wiring, optional fields staying unmarked and focus on the first invalid control.

test_references.name: explains an invalid email address and clears the error when the address is corrected
test_references.supports: Checks the invalid-email message and that no draft opens for invalid input; correcting the field clears the message.

test_references.name: rejects a negative offered hourly rate with a Swedish message
test_references.supports: Checks the negative-rate message and aria-invalid on the rate input; no draft is opened.

test_references.name: keeps validation in helper functions so optional fields stay out of the error set
test_references.supports: Checks the validation helper directly: error key order, the missing-rate and non-numeric-rate messages, the malformed-email message and optional fields staying outside the set.

test_references.name: keeps quote and inquiry form field boundaries at WCAG AA non-text contrast on white
test_references.supports: Stylesheet check pins the 1px hex border color of the inquiry input and textarea boundary rule at 3:1 non-text contrast on white, alongside the quote-page equivalents. It reads the page CSS only and does not render the form.

preconditions: The /inhyrning/ route document has loaded.
The typed Inhyrning route is declared in the registry.
flow: Open /inhyrning/ from the header Inhyrning link or a not-found shortcut.
Enter Företagets namn, Kontaktperson and E-post; Telefon and Organisationsnummer are optional.
Enter what help is needed, the offered hourly rate and how long the assignment runs.
Describe the assignment in Beskriv ärendet.
variants: Missing required fields show a role=alert summary, one Swedish message per field, aria-invalid/aria-describedby and focus on the first invalid field.
A malformed email and a missing, non-numeric or negative rate each get their own Swedish message; correcting a field clears its message.
The rate field's description carries the note about stating whether the price includes or excludes VAT.
user_stories.expected_outcome: The visitor completes every required staffing detail or learns in Swedish exactly which field blocks the handoff; no draft opens while input is invalid.
user_stories.failure_behavior: The page cannot verify company details beyond shape checks; visitors correct the named fields from the messages.
user_stories.recovery: Read the per-field messages and correct the named inputs; the guidance aside lists what to include.

user_stories.title: Send the prepared staffing draft yourself
user_stories.action: hand the completed inquiry draft to the own email program and send it
user_stories.benefit: review and send the staffing request from a trusted email tool

test_references.name: opens a mail draft to the existing contact address with every supplied detail and explains the manual send
test_references.supports: Checks the handed-off mailto recipient, subject and decoded body values, the injected draft opener call, the role=status self-send confirmation with the recipient address and the fallback link carrying the same draft. Uses an injected opener, so it does not exercise a real email program.

test_references.name: marks empty optional fields with a dash in the mail draft without blocking the handoff
test_references.supports: Checks the dash placeholders for empty optional fields and the absence of an alert on the successful handoff.

test_references.name: keeps white primary-foreground labels readable on primary buttons at WCAG AA
test_references.supports: Token-level stylesheet check pins the white --primary-foreground label against the --primary button surface at 4.5:1, the pairing this story's Skicka förfrågan submit button renders through the shared primary button variant. It reads the root tokens only; the quote pages' send button override is pinned separately by the page-accent check below.

test_references.name: keeps the quote send CTA white label readable on its primary token surface at WCAG AA
test_references.supports: Page-level stylesheet check resolves the quote send button's token-based background and label declarations against the root tokens and pins the white-on-primary pairing at 4.5:1, covering the page override that the shared primary button variant alone did not.

preconditions: All required fields contain valid values.
A mail client is configured for the handoff.
flow: Complete the staffing inquiry form with valid values.
Select Skicka förfrågan.
The page hands a mailto draft to kontakt@svardentreprenad.se with the subject Förfrågan om inhyrning and a labeled body to the email program.
Read the role=status confirmation that the draft awaits review and that the visitor sends the email themselves.
If the email program did not open, follow Öppna utkastet igen or copy the displayed address.
variants: Empty optional fields are marked with a dash in the draft body instead of blocking the handoff.
The static help line beside the submit button states the draft handoff and the manual send before submitting.
user_stories.expected_outcome: The form requests a mailto handoff to kontakt@svardentreprenad.se with the staffing subject and details; the visitor sends the email themselves and delivery is not established.
user_stories.failure_behavior: The mail handler may fail to open; the page cannot confirm acceptance or sending.
user_stories.recovery: Use the reopen-draft fallback link or copy the displayed address and details into working email software; the site offers no persistent draft recovery or alternate transport.

capability.current_limitations: Totals are client-side estimates from fixed source-price constants carrying the standing unconfirmed VAT label; no calculation state is saved or shareable, and a configured mail client plus the browser print dialog carry the handoff.
capability.failure_behavior: Invalid measurements replace the total with a Swedish role=alert message, mark the input and disable the email and print controls; a missing or incompatible mail client can prevent handoff without a site error receipt.
capability.recovery: Correct the named measurement or use Återställ exempel; use the displayed address in a working email tool when the handoff fails.
capability.customer_outcome: Visitors get a self-serve preliminary cost picture for husdränering or an asfalterad uppfart before deciding to engage the company.
outcome_signals: In an observed task, a visitor selects husdränering or uppfart and sees one preliminary total for the entered measurements.
A valid calculation exposes the Begär offert mailto draft with the measurements and total and a print/PDF path, with nothing sent automatically.
Invalid input shows a Swedish blocking message instead of a misleading total.

user_stories.title: Choose the calculator for the project
user_stories.action: choose between the husdränering and uppfart calculators
user_stories.benefit: get a preliminary quote for the right project type

test_references.name: starts with two calculator choice buttons before any calculator fields
test_references.supports: Checks the choice heading, both choice-link destinations and that no quantity fields, asphalt checkbox, result heading or alert exists before choosing.

test_references.name: reveals only the uppfart calculator after choosing uppfart
test_references.supports: Checks that the choice buttons disappear, the back link targets /offertberakning/ and only the driveway fields appear.

test_references.name: links visitors with a driveway project back to the quote calculator
test_references.supports: Checks the drainage page's /offertberakning/ cross-link destination.

preconditions: The /offertberakning/ route document has loaded.
flow: Open /offertberakning/ from the header Kalkyler Uppfart link, the footer, a not-found shortcut or the drainage calculator's Räkna på uppfart cross-link.
Read Vad gäller din offertförfrågan? and choose Räkna på husdränering or Räkna på uppfart.
On the drainage page, follow Räkna på uppfart back to the driveway calculator.
variants: Räkna på husdränering links to /draneringsberakning/ and Räkna på uppfart links to the #uppfart hash; no calculator fields or result are visible before a choice.
The #uppfart hash reveals only the driveway calculator; Välj annan kalkyl returns to the choice view and the hash change listener keeps the view in sync.
The drainage page offers Räkna på uppfart as a plain link to /offertberakning/.
user_stories.expected_outcome: The visitor works in exactly one calculator whose fields and result match the chosen project type.
user_stories.failure_behavior: No calculation is created by visiting the choice view; the visitor can change the choice at any time.
user_stories.recovery: Choose again through the choice view, the Kalkyler disclosure or the cross-links.

user_stories.title: See a total-only preliminary total for the entered measurements
user_stories.action: enter measurements and read the announced preliminary total
user_stories.benefit: gauge the cost before making contact

test_references.name: reveals only the uppfart calculator after choosing uppfart
test_references.supports: Checks the example defaults, the checked asphalt box, the result heading, the Preliminärt underlag caption, the example total, the VAT-status label and the disclaimer.

test_references.name: recalculates the reused driveway calculation into a preliminary total
test_references.supports: Checks the recalculated totals for a changed area and an unchecked asphalt box and that no price-breakdown markup exists.

test_references.name: describes the quantity fields and announces updates in a polite live region
test_references.supports: Checks the shared field-description association and the polite atomic live region announcing the updated total.

test_references.name: presents the drainage estimate without internal prices or part amounts
test_references.supports: Checks the drainage headings, scope summary, caption, VAT-status label and disclaimer and the absence of internal prices and breakdown markup.

test_references.name: calculates $meters löpmeter to $expected kr on the page and in the email
test_references.supports: Parameterized 40/55/60-meter cases check the on-page totals.

test_references.name: supports decimal lengths and keeps the same precision in the email
test_references.supports: Checks a decimal length's total on the page.

test_references.name: describes the length field and announces updates in a polite live region
test_references.supports: Checks the field description association and the polite atomic live region announcing the updated total.

test_references.name: keeps quote and inquiry form field boundaries at WCAG AA non-text contrast on white
test_references.supports: Stylesheet check pins the 1px hex border color of the quote input and select/textarea boundary rules at 3:1 non-text contrast on white, alongside the inquiry-page equivalents. It reads the page CSS only and does not render the calculator.

test_references.name: keeps quote form text-entry controls at a font size of at least 16px
test_references.supports: Stylesheet check pins an explicit px font-size of at least 16 on the quote quantity-input rule and the shared quote-field select/textarea rule in the page CSS, the iOS Safari focus-zoom floor fk199 delivered. It reads the stylesheet source only and does not render the calculator or execute iOS zoom behavior.

test_references.name: bills the first 55 meters at 3 500 kr per meter plus the fixed cost
test_references.supports: Helper-level check pins the first drainage tier at 3 500 kr per meter plus the 6 900 kr fixed cost; the page declarations above check the rendered totals built on it.

test_references.name: bills only meters above the 55 meter boundary at 3 000 kr per meter
test_references.supports: Helper-level check pins the above-boundary drainage tier at 3 000 kr per meter, including fractional lengths.

test_references.name: keeps the 6 900 kr fixed cost at zero meters
test_references.supports: Helper-level check pins the fixed establishment amount at zero meters.

test_references.name: accepts fractional meters like the page input allows
test_references.supports: Helper-level check that decimal lengths price through the same drainage tiers, matching the decimal input the page accepts.

test_references.name: charges the area at 950 kr per square meter plus fixed and load costs without asphalt
test_references.supports: Helper-level check pins driveway pricing at 950 kr per square meter plus the fixed preparation amount and per-load costs without asphalt.

test_references.name: adds 667 kr per square meter when asphalt is included
test_references.supports: Helper-level check pins the asphalt surcharge at 667 kr per square meter; the page declarations check the rendered asphalt totals.

test_references.name: adds 2 000 kr per load
test_references.supports: Helper-level check pins the per-load cost at 2 000 kr.

test_references.name: formats money in kronor with non-breaking grouping and a decimal comma
test_references.supports: Helper-level check pins sv-SE money formatting with non-breaking grouping and a decimal comma, the format the rendered total and email body carry.

test_references.name: formats numbers with grouping and a decimal comma without a currency unit
test_references.supports: Helper-level check pins sv-SE number formatting without a currency unit, used for the measurements in the email draft.

test_references.name: exports the exact VAT status label constant
test_references.supports: Helper-level check pins the exact Momsstatus ej bekräftad constant that the rendered result aside and the email body carry.

preconditions: A calculator is selected (uppfart via the #uppfart hash, husdränering via /draneringsberakning/).
flow: Enter Uppfartens yta and Antal lass, or Dräneringens längd in löpmeter.
Read the help text under the fields and the Det här ingår scope summary on the drainage page.
Read the announced Beräknad totalsumma, the currency total and Momsstatus ej bekräftad in the Din kostnadsbild aside.
Read the disclaimer that this is an estimate, not a binding quote, and that ROT deduction and payment terms are specified in the real quote.
variants: The driveway calculator starts from the example values 100 m², 1 lass and the checked Inkludera asfalt checkbox; unchecking asphalt recalculates the total.
The drainage calculator starts from the example 40 löpmeter and accepts decimal lengths with the same precision on the page and in the email.
Totals recalculate on every change and are announced through an aria-live polite, aria-atomic region.
Only the total is shown: no unit prices, part amounts or price-breakdown sections exist in the customer view.
user_stories.expected_outcome: The visitor sees exactly one preliminary total for the entered measurements, clearly labeled as unconfirmed regarding VAT and non-binding.
user_stories.failure_behavior: The website cannot confirm a binding price; the disclaimer directs scope confirmation to the real quote discussion.
user_stories.recovery: Adjust the measurements or continue to the email handoff; no binding offer is created on the site.

user_stories.title: Recover from invalid measurements
user_stories.action: read the Swedish feedback for invalid measurements and correct or reset them
user_stories.benefit: avoid acting on a misleading total

test_references.name: blocks invalid quantities without a misleading result and resets the calculator
test_references.supports: Checks the Swedish alert, the absent email link, the disabled result and print controls, the absent total for empty and negative values and the reset behavior.

test_references.name: blocks the invalid length %s without a misleading result
test_references.supports: Parameterized empty, zero, negative and over-limit cases check the alert, aria-invalid, the disabled email and print controls and the absent total.

test_references.name: restores the example and clears the project description
test_references.supports: Checks that reset restores the example length, clears the note and the alert and leaves a valid email handoff.

preconditions: A calculator is selected with an entered measurement.
flow: Enter an invalid value: a non-positive or over-limit area, a fractional number of loads, or an empty, non-positive or over-limit drainage length.
Read the role=alert Swedish message and the marked input instead of a total.
Correct the value or select Återställ exempel to restore the example values and clear the note.
variants: The driveway message is Ange en yta större än 0, ett helt antal lass och högst 100 000. while the area or loads are invalid; the drainage message is Ange en längd större än 0 och högst 100 000 meter..
While input is invalid, no Beräknad totalsumma is rendered, the input carries aria-invalid, and the email and print controls are disabled or replaced by a disabled Kontrollera dina uppgifter button.
Återställ exempel restores the example measurements, the default asphalt choice and an empty note, clearing the alert.
user_stories.expected_outcome: The visitor never sees a stale total alongside invalid input and can recover by correcting the named value or resetting the example.
user_stories.failure_behavior: The page performs shape and range checks only; it cannot judge whether the entered measurements fit the real project.
user_stories.recovery: Correct the named measurement or reset the example; the disclaimer keeps scope confirmation with the company.

user_stories.title: Print or save the preliminary quote as PDF
user_stories.action: print or save the preliminary quote through the browser print dialog
user_stories.benefit: keep or share the cost picture outside the browser session
preconditions: A calculator shows a valid preliminary total.
flow: Enter valid measurements and read the announced total.
Select Skriv ut / spara som PDF to open the browser's print dialog.
Keep or share the printed page; it carries the same total-only content as the view.
variants: Both calculators expose the same print control in the Din kostnadsbild aside; it stays disabled while input is invalid.
user_stories.expected_outcome: The visitor can hand the preliminary total to paper or a PDF through the browser's own print path; the website produces no separate document, file or stored quote.
user_stories.failure_behavior: The website cannot confirm that a printout or PDF was produced; browser and printer availability stay outside the site.
user_stories.recovery: Retry the print control or read the total on screen; no print invocation is covered by a reviewed declaration, so the printed rendering remains an unmapped gap.

user_stories.title: Hand off the quote request by email
user_stories.action: hand the measurements and preliminary total to the company by email
user_stories.benefit: start the discussion from the same numbers

test_references.name: keeps the email handoff about the uppfart without internal prices
test_references.supports: Checks the mailto recipient, subject, decoded body values including the Asfalt answer and unconfirmed VAT label, the confirmed-scope line and the absence of internal prices.

test_references.name: calculates $meters löpmeter to $expected kr on the page and in the email
test_references.supports: Parameterized 40/55/60-meter cases check the drainage subject, length line, preliminary sum and the absence of internal prices in the email.

test_references.name: supports decimal lengths and keeps the same precision in the email
test_references.supports: Checks the decimal length's precision in the email body.

test_references.name: replaces every known {key} placeholder with its value
test_references.supports: Helper-level check pins template substitution for every known placeholder in the draft body template.

test_references.name: keeps unknown placeholders untouched
test_references.supports: Helper-level check pins that unknown placeholders stay literal instead of vanishing from the draft body.

test_references.name: percent-encodes the subject and the filled body in a mailto URL
test_references.supports: Helper-level check pins the mailto URL construction with its percent-encoded subject and filled body that the Begär offert control hands to the email program.

test_references.name: keeps unknown placeholders and encodes their braces in the body
test_references.supports: Helper-level check pins brace encoding of leftover unknown placeholders so the draft URL stays valid.

test_references.name: keeps the quote send CTA white label readable on its primary token surface at WCAG AA
test_references.supports: Page-level stylesheet check pins the white label on the token-based Begär offert send button surface at 4.5:1.

preconditions: A calculator shows a valid preliminary total.
A mail client is configured for the handoff.
flow: Optionally add the project note with place, current substrate and desired timing.
Select Begär offert på underlaget.
Review and send the prepared draft in the own email program.
Read Öppnar ditt e-postprogram. Inget skickas automatiskt. beside the control.
variants: The driveway draft has the subject Offertförfrågan – uppfart and a body with Yta, Antal lass, the Asfalt answer, the preliminary sum labeled momsstatus ej bekräftad and Omfattning behöver bekräftas; unchecking asphalt changes the Asfalt answer.
The drainage draft has the subject Offertförfrågan – husdränering and a body with the length in löpmeter, the preliminary sum and Omfattning behöver bekräftas.
Both drafts address kontakt@svardentreprenad.se and never contain internal unit prices, fixed costs or part amounts.
user_stories.expected_outcome: The email program receives a draft carrying the entered measurements and the preliminary total; the visitor sends it themselves and delivery is not established.
user_stories.failure_behavior: The mail handler may fail to open; the page cannot confirm acceptance or sending.
user_stories.recovery: Copy the address and details into a working email tool; the site offers no persistent draft recovery or alternate transport.
